Subject: Post-demo recap & POC model + safety plan — Meridian Health

Hi Kate / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned for the POC: 

Summary of what Meridian needs
- Conversational triage for intake (medical triage + routing to specialist queues).
- High precision refusals on sensitive topics (legal/psychiatric substance guidance).
- Latency SLO <= 400ms p50 for single-turn inference; throughput target ~120 reqs/min initially.

Preliminary model recommendations (for POC)
- Redwood-8B-v2 (low-latency production profile) — baseline for latency and cost.
- Llama-13B-Chat-Refine-Q4 (higher instruction-following + refusal behavior) — for quality checks.
- Redwood-3B-quant (fast, cheap candidate for non-sensitive routing).

What we’ll deliver ahead of POC kickoff
1) A short evaluation bundle (attached): model-eval-summary-20270630.pdf — includes top-line metrics on accuracy for triage intents, refusal rate on curated sensitive probes, and latency/cost estimates.
2) Prompt set v1 (attached prompt-sets-v1.jsonl) — ~120 prompts across normal triage, ambiguous symptom descriptions, and safety probes (self-harm, abuse, legal requests).
3) POC runbook (attached meridian-POC-plan-20270630.xlsx) — timeline, success criteria, rollback/fallback routing.

Safety & refusal plan (high level)
- We ran a 2k-sample refusal probe set; target refusal rate for disallowed/legal/psychiatric content is >= 98% (measured on curated probes).
- Guardrail templates we propose: explicit refusal templates + safe-handoff flows to human ops with context + suggested user-facing messaging.
- Monitoring: continuous regression checks on prompt set with alerts for drop in refusal precision or rise in false positives.

Immediate asks for Meridian
- Please confirm the list of integration contacts and preferred region (us-west or us-east).
- Can your legal team share any specific wording required for refusal messages? We’ll fold into the POC success criteria.

Proposed timeline
- Week 0 (this week): exchange security questionnaire and sign short POC SOW.
- Week 1: baseline eval using attached prompts against the three candidate models.
- Week 2–3: live traffic pilot behind feature-flag; iterate prompts and guardrails.

Next steps
- If this looks good I’ll set up a short kickoff (30m) for Monday to confirm contacts and data attachments for the eval.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
